
## NumPy functions

```{python}
list_of_names = ['Pete', 'Paul', 'John']

list_of_names
```

```{python}
np.repeat(list_of_names, 20)
```

```{python}
list_of_ages = [76, 23, 43]

list_of_ages
```

```{python}
np.mean(list_of_ages)
```

```{python}
np.sum(list_of_ages)
```

## NumPy Arrays


NumPy arrays are like the smarter, better-looking version of lists.

```{python}
my_list = [10, 11, 35]

my_list
```

```{python}
my_list[0]
```

```{python}
my_list[1]
```

```{python}
my_list[2]
```

```{python}
my_array = np.array(my_list)

my_array
```

```{python}
my_array[0]
```

```{python}
my_array[1]
```

```{python}
my_array[2]
```

```{python}
np.sum(my_array)
```

```{python}
np.mean(my_array)
```

```{python}
my_array.sum()
```

```{python}
my_array.mean()
```
